Build against Acme Notes API S21 api_version v1 with api.base_path AX-63003 and api.error_format AX-40567. Facts for earlier sprints (S01..S20, e.g. v2, v12, v40) disagree on the version but belong to other sprints; the S21 facts govern and match repo/api.py.

Use the security team's scheme (RS256 JWT bearer tokens, 15-minute expiry) for all user traffic; it governs over Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key because long-lived keys are a larger exposure. Globex's request is not rejected: its non-interactive back-office need is deferred to a separate, scoped service-credential option (short-lived tokens via a client-credentials style flow) to be designed later, not enabled as a general auth method now.
Adopt API v2 for Acme Notes API S21, per the researcher's updated api_version fact; it supersedes the earlier version choice, so endpoint design must be updated for v2.

Approve the CRUD spec. The S21 API version is v2 (not the older-sprint values v4..v30), and api.base_path AX-63003 in the facts matches the code. No S21 auth fact exists, so earlier-sprint auth_method facts (S01-S03) were not applied to S21.
Approve the CRUD spec: it is consistent with the current S21 API version v2. Recall returned no S21 auth fact, so none was relied on.
